prompt:
Rewrite snippets/product-dimension-list.liquid so it renders a product's measurements with correct counts and pluralization. Inputs (all top-level variables; there is no section object): - `dimensions`: array, never null, possibly empty. Every element is an object that always has all four keys: - `label`: string, never null. - `value`: non-negative integer, or null. - `unit`: string, never null. This is the singular unit name. - `unit_plural`: string, or null. - `limit`: integer >= 1, or null. Null means no limit. Rules: 1. A dimension is valid when its `value` is not null. Dimensions with a null value are ignored everywhere: they are not counted and not listed. 2. Let TOTAL be the number of valid dimensions. If TOTAL is 0, output nothing at all (the empty string). 3. Otherwise, output exactly this, with no whitespace or newlines between or around tags: `

TOTAL measurement(s)

    ITEMS MORE
` - The count text is `1 measurement` when TOTAL is 1. Otherwise it is `TOTAL measurements`. 4. ITEMS: walk `dimensions` in their original order and output one `
  • LABEL: VALUE UNITWORD
    • ` for each valid dimension until SHOWN valid dimensions have been output. SHOWN is TOTAL, or `limit` when `limit` is not null and is smaller than TOTAL. The limit counts valid dimensions only, not array positions, so null-value entries never use up the limit. - UNITWORD rules: - When `value` is exactly 1, UNITWORD is `unit`. - Otherwise (including 0), UNITWORD is `unit_plural` when it is not null. - Otherwise, UNITWORD is `unit` with the letter `s` appended. - LABEL and UNITWORD are HTML-escaped with the `escape` filter. VALUE is output as the plain integer. 5. MORE: let REST = TOTAL - SHOWN. - If REST > 0, append `
  • and REST more dimension
    • ` when REST is 1. - Otherwise (REST > 1), append `
  • and REST more dimensions
    • `. - If REST is 0, append nothing. Example: two valid dimensions, Width 2 (unit inch, plural inches) and Depth 1 (unit foot), with no limit, give: `

    2 measurements

    • Width: 2 inches
    • Depth: 1 foot
    ` Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/product-dimension-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
